fusions.name: Sodden Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a sodden weight that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Marsh Slap
fusions.desc: Slaps the wet ground ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sweating Venom
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Spring
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6, they all spend at once, and a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack.
